results.title: Jordan bans Telegram app over 'radicalisation' claims
results.content: Jordan has imposed a ban on Telegram over a deadly church attack which left seven people dead. The kingdom claims that content on the messaging app poses a threat to "national interests."

results.title: Mozambique's justice under scrutiny as Venancio Mondlane faces trial
results.content: The trial of opposition politician Venancio Mondlane begins in Mozambique on Tuesday. The former presidential candidate is facing five charges, including incitement to terrorism.

results.title: Goodbye, overtourism? Sustainable travel gains ground
results.content: As tourism booms across Latin America, alternative forms of travel are gaining ground. Making your holiday more sustainable means rethinking who calls the shots, who invests and who benefits.

results.title: Despite restrictive abortion laws, Poland's 'Abortomat' — a locker that dispenses abortion pills — helps women who want to end a pregnancy
results.content: Abortion laws in Poland are very restrictive. Activists there have found a new way to help women wanting to terminate a pregnancy: the "Abortomat," a locker that dispenses abortion pills. But they face fierce opposition.

results.title: ASEAN offers Myanmar's sidelined leaders a path back to summits, but says restrictions will stay until there is meaningful progress on its peace plan
results.content: Southeast Asian leaders have agreed to engage Myanmar in stages after years of excluding its leaders from high-level meetings. The bloc says Myanmar could regain full representation if it makes progress on a peace plan.

results.title: Nigeria's upcoming election marred by rising AI disinformation
results.content: As Nigeria inches closer to the 2027 polls, the use of artificial intelligence in the electoral process has prompted questions about integrity and institutional readiness. Can Nigerians trust their democratic processes?

results.title: Fact check: 'Iranian' content farms reach millions
results.content: Several social media accounts claiming to represent the Iranian military show signs of being part of so-called content farms. DW Fact Check looks at how they operate and how users can spot them.

results.title: COP31: Protesters, UN urge swift climate deal
results.content: The UN climate chief has warned that "tactical delays" at the COP31 climate talks in Turkey could prevent a deal to slow global warming.

results.title: Ukraine: Zelenskyy says security deal could go to referendum
results.content: The US has broached the idea of Kyiv giving up the Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership, the Ukrainian president said.

results.title: New facilities in Laos and Cambodia: Is China expanding its military presence in Southeast Asia?
results.content: China has been growing its economic relationships in Southeast Asia. Now new military facilities in Laos and Cambodia are causing smaller countries to worry China's military networks are also expanding.

results.title: Microsoft says all services working again
results.content: US tech giant Microsoft says it has fixed problems that led to a global outage of its services. The glitch severely disrupted online communications in businesses and governments for more than 24 hours.
